integrity: The analytical proof establishes the infinite parameter family; finite exact and numerical checks only support arithmetic. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform real balls and their centered symmetric slabs only; complex total-degree-at-most-two polynomials, d at least 2.
The thin-slab expansion is for each fixed dimension and is not uniform in dimension.
No assertion for higher-degree polynomial spaces, shifted slabs, weighted balls or other bandwidth conventions.
Historical priority remains provisional: equivalent broader Jacobi-polynomial or spectral concentration formulas could exist outside searched literature.
title: Universal six-level ordering for quadratic-polynomial concentration in a central ball slab
